summary: Verified /dados-inscricao.html loading spinner fix. Clicking CONTINUAR when all required fields (Edital, Cargo, Macropolo=NACIONAL, Polo-trab, UF=RN, Polo-prova=NATAL) and #d-declaro are set displays the #dados-loading overlay (computed display=flex) and then navigates to /confirmacao.html after ~1s. When button is disabled, clicking does NOT show overlay and does NOT navigate. Confirmação page correctly shows 'Dados pessoais' section (placeholders since step 2 not filled in this test) and 'Opções de prova' section with Cargo (AUXILIAR DE SAÚDE (ASA)), Polo de trabalho (NACIONAL), UF (RN) and Polo de prova (NATAL).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: CSP console warnings for Cloudflare beacon/challenge scripts (script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:) — cosmetic, unrelated to fix.

The setTimeout navigation (1000ms) is hardcoded; acceptable for the requested UX but if page load is fast on next screen there is no reason to also delay real work — currently no real request is triggered, only cosmetic spinner. Consider documenting this intent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Spinner overlay #dados-loading on dados-inscricao.html works. Fields to fill in order: #d-edital=2026.1, #d-cargo (index 1), #d-macropolo=NACIONAL, #d-polo-trab=NACIONAL, #d-uf=RN, #d-polo-prova=NATAL, check #d-declaro. Button #bt-continuar-dados loses .disabled class only after all filled.
